reviews.detail: Three independent skill activities have Job Levels 35/30/30. Legacy metadata retained only the first header. job_level_scope_step preserves that first value as a non-eligibility source summary while stage requirements govern each activity.

Pinned HTML restores all three omitted material tables. Armor is an equippable retained category, not a consumed fixed item ID. Fatal Blow table establishes one Banana Juice although its header omits quantity. Town house/shop points have no invented interior map codes.
